fields.name: __change_type
fields.doc: Indicates how the row is to be processed: Insert, Update, Delete, upsert/Autocorrect, eXterminate, Truncate,...

fields.name: __truncate
fields.doc: In case of a change type of TRUNCATE, this map contains the fields to identify the set of rows to be deleted

fields.name: __change_time
fields.doc: Timestamp of the transaction. All rows of the transaction have the same value.

fields.name: __source_rowid
fields.doc: Optional unqiue and static pointer to the row, e.g. Oracle rowid

fields.name: __source_transaction
fields.doc: Optional source transaction information for auditing

fields.name: __source_system
fields.doc: Optional source system information for auditing

fields.name: __extension_map
fields.doc: Add more values as a map beyond the official logical data model

fields.name: __audit
fields.doc: If data is transformed, this information is recorded here

fields.name: __transformresult
fields.doc: Is the record PASS, FAILED or WARN?

fields.name: __transformationname
fields.doc: A name identifying the applied transformation

fields.name: __transformresult
fields.doc: Is the record PASS, FAIL or WARN?

fields.name: __transformresult_text
fields.doc: Transforms can optionally describe what they did

fields.name: __transformresult_quality
fields.doc: Transforms can optionally return a percent value from 0 (FAIL) to 100 (PASS)

datatype.name: __audit
datatype.doc: If data is transformed this information is recorded here
